verdict.rationale: Customer.io gives AI agents broad programmatic reach. The CLI offers 'full access' to workspaces through a single `cio api` command with structured JSON output, and the MCP server can 'do just about anything you can do in Customer.io'. Some operations are inherently many-item, such as broadcasts queued to all defined recipients, segment-based targeting, and warehouse reverse ETL syncs. But the evidence documents no explicit bulk or batch API, and no agent-driven multi-item editing or deletion, so bulk work is only implied through scripting or audience-level sends. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk endpoints (e.g., bulk profile updates or deletes), explicit agent support for acting on many automations, messages or profiles in one operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
